english.title: Helicopter operator or pilot in command on Performance Class 3 operation fly unlawfully with passenger
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a helicopter registered in the United Kingdom carrying out a Performance Class 3 operation, namely **(..SPECIFY HELICOPTER..), that was equipped with the required apparatus and was flying on a flight under and in accordance with the terms of a police air operator's certificate and on which

(C)_[was carried a passenger who was not a permitted passenger, when it flew in the specified circumstances on a flight for more than 20 minutes]_
(D)_[no passenger was carried other than a permitted passenger, when it flew over water on a flight for more than 10 minutes while more than five minutes from a point from which it could make an autorotative descent to land suitable for an emergency landing]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 129(4) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
